long_biography.plain_text:
Mesnard left France for the Maldives at nineteen and built a career around diving. He established a dive business, initially chartering boats for clients, before developing his own luxury surf and diving operation. As a freediving and scuba instructor, he created breath-control training for surfers, using relaxation, mindset and underwater techniques to improve confidence during difficult conditions.

After years of ocean-based hospitality, Mesnard shifted his family base to Namibia. Through Divine Namibia, he now leads bespoke wilderness expeditions and draws on his freediving background to teach breathing and meditation in a different landscape. The company offers guided desert, wildlife and family journeys, with Mesnard bringing specialist instruction to small groups in remote settings.
